articles.summary: New York, NY, June 20, 2025/PRNewswire – Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“LFT” or the “Company”) announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.06 per share of common stock with respect to the second quarter of 2025. The dividend is payable on July 15, 2025, to common stockholders of record as of the close of business
articles.title: LFT Declares Q2 2025 Common & Preferred Dividends
